Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1136 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Amber Jones in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on 06/17/2024. Our
client was proceeding through an intersection while making a left turn when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's
side of our client's car. The police report and the photographs taken at the scene document the point of impact and
the resulting damage.
As a dierct result of the collision, our client suffered a neck strain that has caused ongoing pain, stiffness, and limited
range of motion. Our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has followed the treatment plan recommended by
the treating physician, including physical therapy and prescribed medication. Records confirm that the symptoms
began immediately after the impact and have continued to affect daily activities, work duties, and sleep.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to yield the right of way and caused the collision. Our client bears
no responsibility for what occurred.
Accordingly, we demand payment of $31,000.00 to resolve all claims ariisng from this incident. This offer will remain
open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will
file suit without further notice to your company.
Please direct all future correspondence regarding this claim to our office.
Expert review: Curtis James, biomechanical engineer
Sincerely,
Debra Moody
Brown & Shaw Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
